description: This file defines the RouteProcessorCsrf class, which handles CSRF token processing for outbound routes in Drupal, including generating tokens, placeholders, and rendering CSRF tokens via lazy callbacks.

classes.name: RouteProcessorCsrf
classes.description: Handles CSRF token processing for outbound routes, including token generation, placeholders, and lazy rendering.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RouteProcessorCsrf object, injecting CSRF token generator and request stack, with deprecation warning if request stack is not provided.

methods.name: processOutbound
methods.description: Processes outbound routes to add CSRF tokens or placeholders based on request format and route requirements.

methods.name: renderPlaceholderCsrfToken
methods.description: Render API callback that returns a CSRF token markup for a given path, with session context caching.

methods.name: trustedCallbacks
methods.description: Returns list of trusted callback functions, specifically 'renderPlaceholderCsrfToken'.
